mapper.select: SELECT facematch.trans_id AS transId, crosscheck.selfie_img AS image1, facematch.selfie_img_01 AS image2, facematch.result_code AS result FROM tbl_facematch_data facematch INNER JOIN tbl_crosscheck_data crosscheck ON facematch.trans_id = crosscheck.trans_id WHERE facematch.trans_id = #{transId} AND facematch.is_latest = 'Y' LIMIT 1
